constraint.rule: DoD document must be concise and actionable (target ~100 lines)
Use markdown checklist format for easy verification
Include executable commands where applicable (pytest, ruff)
DoD must align with existing CI/CD enforcement (Story 4.0.1)
Coverage threshold is 80% for new code (not negotiable)
Coverage ratchet prevents any decrease (not negotiable)
This is a documentation-only story - no code changes to production modules
May add DoD reference to story template or README (minor edit)

tests.standards: This is a documentation-only story. Testing consists of manual verification that the DoD document exists, renders correctly in GitHub, and contains all required sections. No automated tests required for documentation content.
